subject: Economy+movement chain fixed and live-verified
body: Findings confirmed + fixed live. Root cause: CostDisplay.FillUp advances per-CALL by Time.deltaTime — the 4Hz pump starved the fill, and every early release refunded coins (CancelFill respawns them as pickups). Plus: completed interactors still report CanBeInteractedWith (skip via reflection now), NavSteerPoint beelined goals when path tails ended >2.5m short (now follows waypoints — killed the building-pin), hard-stuck snap dropped the hero into the same cage (now escapes to last provably-free pos), and map node-entry no longer walks the map (TransitionFromLevelSelectToLevel + lastActiveLevelInfo + 30s hung-busy -> InteractionBegin fallback). LIVE run: pay x12, choice-pick x5, army-placed x2, switch-night x2, ZERO stuck events. Consumed terrain/slots standPoints directly (94 slots Durststein). Send botpack when you can — same flat shape works.
